original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃基蒂与凯比州议会支持州警察宪法修正案，支持州数达15个
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚埃基蒂州和凯比州议会分别通过法案和决议，支持建立州警察的宪法修正案。此前已有至少13个州通过该法案，目前支持州总数达到15个。该修正案需获得尼日利亚36个州中至少24个州的支持才能通过。

location.raw_text: Ekiti and Kebbi State Houses of Assembly

key_facts.fact: 埃基蒂州和凯比州议会支持建立州警察的宪法修正案
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Ekiti and Kebbi State Houses of Assembly have endorsed the proposed constitutional amendment to pave the way for the establishment of state police

key_facts.fact: 此前至少13个州已通过该法案，支持州总数达到15个
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Before the latest endorsements, at least 13 states — Osun, Edo, Oyo, Rivers, Zamfara, Kwara, Nasarawa, Ogun, Delta, Taraba, Cross River, Plateau and Enugu — had passed the bill.

key_facts.fact: 该修正案需获得36个州中至少24个州的支持
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The constitutional amendment requires the support of at least 24 of Nigeria’s 36 states, representing a two-thirds majority.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
